name: Awa Bank Ltd/The
summary: The Awa Bank, Ltd. is a long-standing Japanese financial institution, delivering a comprehensive array of banking products and services to both individual and corporate clients across Japan. Its financial offerings encompass various deposit accounts, including current, savings, fixed-term, and foreign currency options, alongside certificates of deposit and investment trusts. The bank also extends a wide range of credit facilities, such as loans for housing, renovations, automobiles, credit cards, education, solar energy projects, industrial ventures, and general business support. Furthermore, it provides diverse insurance solutions, covering life, property, academic, and commercial needs, in addition to offering secure storage through safe deposit boxes. Complementing its core banking functions, The Awa Bank supplies online banking, pension services, convenience solutions, and management and business advisory support. Founded in 1896, the institution, which was initially known as Tokushima Commercial Bank, Ltd. before adopting its current name in 1964, operated through a network of 101 branches as of March 31, 2021. Its headquarters are located in Tokushima, Japan.
